heading: Tuesday, September 1, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 and Meta Muse Voice Transcribe.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1
items.summary: Fable 5.1 is generally available and Mythos 5.1, the same model with different safeguards, is limited to vetted users in cybersecurity and life-sciences verification programs. Anthropic reports gains in long-running coding and agentic work at unchanged $10/$50 pricing, with cheaper cache reads.

image.alt: New 300 m Venus elevation model of a small shield volcano produced with Claude

items.headline: Meta releases Muse Voice Transcribe real-time speech model
items.summary: Muse Voice Transcribe is Meta Superintelligence Labs' first real-time audio perception model, offering streaming speech recognition, speaker diarization and transcription trained on 70+ languages. Meta reports a 3.1% word error rate and first place on Artificial Analysis streaming speech-to-text; it is available through the Meta Model API, Meta AI for Mac and Muse Code.
